content:
Amazon OpenSearch Service supports creating multiple use case-speciﬁc workspaces. Each
workspace provides a curated experience for popular use cases such as Observability, Security
Analytics and Search. Workspace also supports collaborator management, so that you can share
your workspace with only your intended collaborators and manage the permissions for each one.
